svg.title: Condenser replacement field workflow

g.aria-label: box title: CONDENSER REPLACEMENT | FIELD WORKFLOW
g.text: CONDENSER REPLACEMENT | FIELD WORKFLOW

g.aria-label: box safety-boundary: QUALIFIED HVAC PERSONNEL ONLY | Use the equipment instructions, adopted codes, electrical safe-work practices, refrigerant rules, and site policy. Stop when a hold point is not proven. Do not substitute this sequence for required procedures or values.
g.text: QUALIFIED HVAC PERSONNEL ONLY | Use the equipment instructions, adopted codes, electrical safe-work practices, refrigerant rules, and site policy. Stop
when a hold point is not proven. Do not substitute this sequence for required procedures or values.

g.aria-label: box confirm: 0 | CONFIRM SCOPE AND EQUIPMENT Match model, voltage, phase, MCA/MOCP, refrigerant, capacity, and approved indoor-system compatibility. Read OEM instructions. Record nameplates and existing condition. Photos P01-P03.
g.text: 0 | CONFIRM SCOPE AND EQUIPMENT
Match model, voltage, phase, MCA/MOCP, refrigerant, capacity, and approved indoor-system
compatibility. Read OEM instructions. Record nameplates and existing condition. Photos

g.aria-label: box isolate: 1 | ISOLATE ALL ENERGY Identify every electrical source, controls, and stored energy. Open disconnect and breaker, apply lockout/tagout, and prove absence of voltage with a rated meter using the required verification method. Photo P04.
g.text: 1 | ISOLATE ALL ENERGY
Identify every electrical source, controls, and stored energy. Open disconnect and
breaker, apply lockout/tagout, and prove absence of voltage with a rated meter using the
required verification method. Photo P04.

g.aria-label: box recover: 2 | RECOVER REFRIGERANT Identify the refrigerant. Use compatible recovery equipment and the correct rated cylinder. Track cylinder limits and record recovered weight. Do not vent. Confirm safe system pressure before opening the circuit. Photos P05-P06.
g.text: 2 | RECOVER REFRIGERANT
Identify the refrigerant. Use compatible recovery equipment and the correct rated
cylinder. Track cylinder limits and record recovered weight. Do not vent. Confirm safe
system pressure before opening the circuit. Photos P05-P06.

g.aria-label: box remove-old: 3 | DOCUMENT AND REMOVE OLD UNIT Label conductors and controls before disconnecting. Protect the circuit from contamination. Disconnect piping using the approved method, cap open ends, release anchors, and move the unit with a planned lift. Photos P07-P09.
g.text: 3 | DOCUMENT AND REMOVE OLD UNIT
Label conductors and controls before disconnecting. Protect the circuit from
contamination. Disconnect piping using the approved method, cap open ends, release
anchors, and move the unit with a planned lift. Photos P07-P09.

g.aria-label: box prepare: 4 | PREPARE SITE AND NEW EQUIPMENT Verify pad, drainage, service access, airflow clearances, line-set condition and sizing, electrical components, overcurrent protection, disconnect, and approved accessories. Correct defects before setting the unit. Photos P10-P11.
g.text: 4 | PREPARE SITE AND NEW EQUIPMENT
Verify pad, drainage, service access, airflow clearances, line-set condition and sizing,
electrical components, overcurrent protection, disconnect, and approved accessories.
Correct defects before setting the unit. Photos P10-P11.

g.aria-label: box install: 5 | SET, CONNECT, AND BRAZE Level and secure the condenser. Route tubing without strain or rub points. Flow nitrogen while brazing where required. Make electrical and control connections to the diagram; torque and protect conductors as specified. Photos P12-P14.
g.text: 5 | SET, CONNECT, AND BRAZE
Level and secure the condenser. Route tubing without strain or rub points. Flow nitrogen
while brazing where required. Make electrical and control connections to the diagram;
torque and protect conductors as specified. Photos P12-P14.

g.aria-label: box test-charge: 6 | PRESSURE TEST, EVACUATE, AND CHARGE Pressure-test and leak-check using approved gas, equipment, limits, and hold time. Evacuate with clean tools and verify the required standing/decay result. Open service valves and establish charge by the approved method. Photos P15-P16.
g.text: 6 | PRESSURE TEST, EVACUATE, AND CHARGE
Pressure-test and leak-check using approved gas, equipment, limits, and hold time.
Evacuate with clean tools and verify the required standing/decay result. Open service
valves and establish charge by the approved method. Photos P15-P16.

g.aria-label: box commission: 7 | START, VERIFY, AND HAND OFF Remove lockout/tagout under the authorized process and energize. Verify rotation where applicable, voltage, current, temperatures, pressures, airflow, drainage, controls, and abnormal sound/vibration. Label, clean, document, and brief the customer. Photos P17-P20.
g.text: 7 | START, VERIFY, AND HAND OFF
Remove lockout/tagout under the authorized process and energize. Verify rotation where
applicable, voltage, current, temperatures, pressures, airflow, drainage, controls, and
abnormal sound/vibration. Label, clean, document, and brief the customer. Photos

g.aria-label: box work-rule: WORK RULE Read one numbered stage. Complete it. Capture its photos. Prove its hold point. Then continue. Never rely on remembering a later step.
g.text: WORK RULE
Read one numbered stage. Complete it. Capture its
photos. Prove its hold point. Then continue. Never
rely on remembering a later step.

g.aria-label: box hold-electrical: HOLD A | ELECTRICAL PROCEED only when all applicable line terminals are proven de-energized and the energy-control boundary is secure. If not proven: STOP.
g.text: HOLD A | ELECTRICAL
PROCEED only when all applicable line terminals are
proven de-energized and the energy-control boundary
is secure. If not proven: STOP.

g.aria-label: box hold-recovery: HOLD B | REFRIGERANT PROCEED only when recovery is complete, cylinder status and weight are documented, and circuit pressure is safe for the planned opening. If not: CONTINUE RECOVERY.
g.text: HOLD B | REFRIGERANT
PROCEED only when recovery is complete, cylinder
status and weight are documented, and circuit
pressure is safe for the planned opening. If not:
CONTINUE RECOVERY.

g.aria-label: box hold-leak: HOLD C | LEAK TEST PROCEED only when the specified pressure test and leak inspection pass. If pressure changes or a leak is found: LOCATE, REPAIR, AND REPEAT.
g.text: HOLD C | LEAK TEST
PROCEED only when the specified pressure test and
leak inspection pass. If pressure changes or a leak
is found: LOCATE, REPAIR, AND REPEAT.

g.aria-label: box hold-vacuum: HOLD D | EVACUATION PROCEED only when the required evacuation and standing/decay result are met. If not: DIAGNOSE LEAKS, MOISTURE, OR TOOL SETUP, THEN REPEAT.
g.text: HOLD D | EVACUATION
PROCEED only when the required evacuation and
standing/decay result are met. If not: DIAGNOSE
LEAKS, MOISTURE, OR TOOL SETUP, THEN REPEAT.

g.aria-label: box footer: SPECIAL REFRIGERANT CHECK | When the equipment or refrigerant has flammability or other special handling requirements, identify that condition before work, control ignition sources, ventilate as required, and use listed compatible service equipment. Record final readings, charge basis, recovered/added weight, model/serial, and all P01-P20 images.
g.text: SPECIAL REFRIGERANT CHECK | When the equipment or refrigerant has flammability or other special handling requirements, identify that condition before work,
control ignition sources, ventilate as required, and use listed compatible service equipment. Record final readings, charge basis, recovered/added weight,
model/serial, and all P01-P20 images.
